lal_singer.text: Flamenco isn't a show for tourists, not in here. It's how people sang about poverty, love, prison and the sea. Cante jondo, deep song.

When it's really good, we say it has duende: a shiver, a something, that you can't explain. You'll know it if you hear it. The palmas, the handclaps, keep the compás, the rhythm. Clap on the wrong beat and everyone will look at you.
